token.description: Hetzner Cloud API token. Can also be set via the HCLOUD_TOKEN environment variable.

block.description: Uploads Talos disk images (*.raw.xz) into Hetzner Cloud and creates snapshot images.

architecture.description: Hetzner snapshot architecture. Valid values: x86 or arm.

debug_skip_cleanup.description: Skip cleanup of temporary server and ssh key. Only use for debugging.

description.description: Description applied to the resulting snapshot image (shown as the snapshot name in the Hetzner Cloud UI).

effective_labels.description: Labels currently set on the snapshot image.

image_id.description: Hetzner snapshot image ID (same as id).

labels.description: Additional labels applied to the resulting snapshot image (must follow Hetzner label rules; label values cannot contain '/').

location.description: Hetzner location name for the temporary upload server. Defaults to fsn1.

server_type.description: Hetzner server type name for the temporary upload server.

create.description: A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

delete.description: A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.

read.description: A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Read operations occur during any refresh or planning operation when refresh is enabled.

block.description: Uploads a Talos disk image (raw.xz) into Hetzner Cloud and creates a snapshot image.
